lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Velvet shadows paint the street
Syncopated heart in every beat
Gliding through the liquid light
Chasing down the edge of night
[chorus]
We are spinning in the glow
Where the cosmic rivers flow
Lost inside the neon haze
Drifting through a solar maze
[verse]
Chromium pulse upon the glass
Watching all the memories pass
Synthetic dreams begin to rise
Reflected in your open eyes
[chorus]
We are spinning in the glow
Where the cosmic rivers flow
Lost inside the neon haze
Drifting through a solar maze
[bridge]
Infinite stars, a binary sea
Gravity pulling you closer to me
Floating on waves of a synth-driven tide
Nowhere to run and nowhere to hide
[chorus]
We are spinning in the glow
Where the cosmic rivers flow
Lost inside the neon haze
Drifting through a solar maze
[outro]
